'''Brain worms''' were worm-like parasites from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] that had the capability of controlling minds. They hatched from yellow eggs, and were known to be used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on her Geonosian minions. The worms would sometimes enter the host via the nose, and were able to control [[Zombie/Legends|dead]] Geonosians.

==Biology==
The brain worms tend to control the nervous system<ref name="CWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> of their hosts through the biologically archived memory of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] queens that used them for certain purposes.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Even when the enthraller was dead they could continue to control living beings independently, being able to act as extensions of deceased Geonosian queens. Further, infection granted their hosts the ability to speak [[Geonosian (language)/Legends|Geonosian]].<ref name=":0" /> The brainwashing trance of the brain worms was so powerful that it could control the corpses of different beings turning them into lifeless zombies, like when the self-proclaimed [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] created an army of zombie Geonosians during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to serve her in her room.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Brain worms reacted negatively to cold temperatures.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] used the worms within her [[Death/Legends|dead]] minions in the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]] to endlessly pursue the search party sent by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to find [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. The search party was led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Queen Karina intended to use them to control the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but didn't succeed in inserting them.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

[[File:Snorting_worms.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A brain worm invading a clone trooper.]]
After the battle, a surviving worm hatched and crawled into one of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] resting outside the Progate Temple. As the company headed to the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]] going to the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]], the infected [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] brought more eggs in his backpack and eventually infected the entire clone crew. The clones took control of the ship, attacking its other members, and proceeded to infect [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] ruptured the ship's coolant system, weakening the worms. Subsequently, Ahsoka and the infected Barriss [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]], but the cold finally got to the worm in Barriss, and Ahsoka killed it as it was crawling out. Barriss and all clone troopers aboard the ship besides a few others were saved. Trap and the other two clones were killed by Barriss and Ahsoka in self-defense, and the pilots were killed by infected clone troopers [[Ox/Legends|Ox]] and [[Edge/Legends|Edge]].<ref name=":0" />

Anakin Skywalker later speculated that use of the parasite might explain how the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] were able to recapture their planet prior to the Second Battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
